articles.title: Gas Cylinder Explodes Outside Theatre, Triggers Panic in Telangana; No Casualties Reported
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic gripped Kodad in Telangana's Suryapet district after a gas cylinder exploded outside Ranga Theatre on Sunday, July 5. A video of the incident, widely shared on social media, shows the cylinder exploding at a tea stall outside the theatre, sending people running for safety.

body.html:
Panic gripped Kodad in Telangana's Suryapet district after a gas cylinder exploded outside Ranga Theatre on Sunday, July 5. A video of the incident, widely shared on social media, shows the cylinder exploding at a tea stall outside the theatre, sending people running for safety.

According to locals, the blast is suspected to have originated from an LPG refill shop near the theatre. However, the exact cause of the explosion is yet to be confirmed.

No casualties or injuries were reported in the incident.

Police have registered a case and launched an investigation to ascertain the cause of the explosion.

In a similar incident on June 30, a loud explosion caused by a suspected gas leak severely damaged an apartment in Hyderabad's Saroornagar. The blast occurred at the residence of Devender, a retired bank employee living in Babunagar under the Saroornagar Police Station limits.

Saroornagar Inspector N. Srisailam had said the explosion occurred at around 10:30 am in the kitchen and that a gas leak was suspected. He added that no formal complaint had been filed regarding the incident.

articles.title: Former Village Head Accused of Grabbing Ancestral Land
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman from Muzaffarnagar has accused a former village head of illegally grabbing her family's ancestral land, and issuing death threats. A video of an altercation between the two at the Sadar Tehsil premises has also gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A woman from Muzaffarnagar has accused a former village head of illegally grabbing her family's ancestral land, and issuing death threats. A video of an altercation between the two at the Sadar Tehsil premises has also gone viral on social media.

The complainant, Devendri, a resident of Mandhera village under Shahpur police station limits, alleged that former village head Mitrasen got the sale deed of her family's ancestral land registered in his name by allegedly offering liquor and other inducements to her father-in-law, but never paid for the land.

According to the woman, she visited the accountant's office at Sadar Tehsil on Saturday for official work, where she encountered Mitrasen. She claimed that when she questioned him about the amount paid for the land and why the payment had not been made, he became enraged, abused her.

The woman further alleged that the accused attempted to kill her and threatened to "take care of her" if she returned to the village. She claimed the confrontation escalated into a scuffle at the tehsil premises, a video of which is now circulating widely on social media.

Following the incident, the victim lodged a complaint at Khalapar Police Station, demanding that an FIR be registered against Mitrasen, a fair investigation be conducted, and security be provided to her family.

The woman alleged that the former village head is an influential person, due to which she and her family are living under constant fear and pressure. She said her family is financially weak and expressed concern for their safety.

As of now, the allegations are based solely on the woman's complaint. The police have not yet presented their version, and the facts of the case will be established only after the investigation is completed.

articles.title: Viral Video Allegedly Shows Businessman Setting Sofa Ablaze, Police Probe Underway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A fire at a businessman's house in Uttar Pradesh's Ghaziabad, initially believed to be accidental, has taken a dramatic turn after a viral video allegedly showed him setting a sofa on fire inside the residence.

body.html:
A fire at a businessman's house in Uttar Pradesh's Ghaziabad, initially believed to be accidental, has taken a dramatic turn after a viral video allegedly showed him setting a sofa on fire inside the residence. Police have launched an investigation to verify the authenticity of the footage and determine whether the blaze was deliberately started.

The incident took place on July 1 at a house in Raj Nagar Sector-14 under the Kavinagar Police Station limits. Firefighters rushed to the spot after receiving information about the blaze and managed to bring the fire under control.

The viral video, which is circulating widely on social media, allegedly shows businessman Mukesh Gupta placing pieces of newspaper on a sofa before setting them on fire. The sofa is then seen catching fire rapidly.

According to reports, the incident was allegedly preceded by a prolonged family dispute. Sources also claimed that Gupta allegedly assaulted his wife, son and daughter before the fire broke out. These allegations have not been officially confirmed by the police.

The fire occurred while women and children were present inside the house. Police said the timely response of firefighters prevented the incident from turning into a major tragedy.

According to reports, Gupta himself allegedly informed the fire department and police after the blaze, making it appear to be an accidental fire. Investigators are examining this aspect as part of the probe.

ACP Kavinagar Suryabali Maurya said police are verifying the authenticity of the viral video and investigating the sequence of events.

"A video showing the fire being started has gone viral on social media. We are verifying the authenticity of the video and investigating the entire incident. Further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation," he said.

Police said no written complaint has been received from the family so far, and no FIR has been registered.

Officials added that if the viral video is found to be genuine and the fire is proven to have been deliberately started, appropriate legal action will be taken under the relevant provisions of law relating to public safety and other offences.

Online discussions have also raised the possibility of an insurance-related motive. However, police have not confirmed any such angle, and it remains a matter of investigation.

articles.title: Diesel Tanker Overturns After Collision, Villagers Rush to Collect Leaking Fuel in UP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A head-on collision between a diesel tanker and a dumper in Uttar Pradesh's Bahraich district led to chaotic scenes after the tanker overturned, prompting villagers to gather with pots and cans to collect the leaking fuel.

body.html:
A head-on collision between a diesel tanker and a dumper in Uttar Pradesh's Bahraich district led to chaotic scenes after the tanker overturned, prompting villagers to gather with pots and cans to collect the leaking fuel.

The accident took place on the highway near Laukia village under the Khairighat Police Station limits.

According to police, the diesel tanker was travelling from Gonda to Nepal, while the dumper was coming from Imamganj in Nanpara. The vehicles collided head-on, and the impact caused the tanker to overturn into a roadside ditch, resulting in a diesel leak.

Soon after the accident, a large number of villagers reached the spot and began collecting the leaking diesel in pots, gallons and other containers.

On receiving information, Khairighat Police Station in-charge Pradeep Singh and his team rushed to the scene. With the help of local residents, police rescued the dumper driver, identified as Ram Ratan, son of Gatti and a resident of Sisular village in Hamirpur district, who had become trapped inside the vehicle.

The injured driver was admitted to a nearby hospital for treatment.

Police also cleared the villagers from the area to prevent any untoward incident. A fire brigade was called to the spot, and water was sprayed on the overturned tanker and the spilled diesel to reduce the risk of fire. Police also prevented people from approaching the accident site.

Khairighat Police Station in-charge Pradeep Singh said the driver was rescued and shifted to the hospital, while timely action by the police and fire brigade helped avert a major accident.

#UttarPradesh #Bahraich #RoadAccident #DieselTanker #BreakingNews

articles.title: Mercedes Co-Passenger Allegedly Slaps Biker in Bengaluru, Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A road rage incident in Bengaluru's Indiranagar has come under the spotlight after a video showing the co-passenger of a Mercedes-Benz allegedly slapping and pushing a biker during an argument went viral on social media.

body.html:
A road rage incident in Bengaluru's Indiranagar has come under the spotlight after a video showing the co-passenger of a Mercedes-Benz allegedly slapping and pushing a biker during an argument went viral on social media.

The incident took place on July 2 at a traffic signal on 12th Main Road in Indiranagar.

According to police, the altercation began when the biker attempted to squeeze through a narrow gap between a Maruti Dzire and the Mercedes-Benz, leading to a heated argument with the luxury car's co-passenger.

The viral video allegedly shows the co-passenger abusing, threatening, slapping and pushing the biker during the confrontation. Passersby reportedly intervened, preventing the situation from escalating further.

Police said they are awaiting a formal complaint from the biker before registering a case and initiating legal action.

The incident has triggered concern over rising cases of road rage in Bengaluru, with many on social media demanding strict action against those involved and stronger measures to curb violence and intimidation on public roads.

articles.title: Wedding That Will Never Happen’: Alleged Snapchat Chat Emerges in Ketan Agarwal Murder Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An alleged Snapchat conversation linked to accused Siya Goyal has emerged as a new focus in the investigation into the murder of Ketan Agarwal.

body.html:
An alleged Snapchat conversation linked to accused Siya Goyal has emerged as a new focus in the investigation into the murder of Ketan Agarwal.

According to sources, investigators are examining a chat in which Siya allegedly asked a friend to send both the front and back copies of her Aadhaar card for flight ticket bookings, while stating that the tickets were for a wedding "that is never going to happen."

Sources claim the alleged message read: "Send your Aadhaar card front and back for wedding tickets for a wedding that is never going to happen."

Police are investigating whether any flight tickets were actually booked and whether the alleged travel arrangements were intended to create the impression that preparations for Siya Goyal's marriage to Ketan Agarwal were progressing normally.

Investigators are also examining whether the alleged conversation forms part of a broader conspiracy to conceal the murder plot and avoid raising suspicion before the crime.

The authenticity of the alleged Snapchat conversation and its evidentiary value have not yet been established.

Police have not officially confirmed the contents of the alleged chat, and the investigation is ongoing.

#KetanAgarwal #MurderCase #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #PoliceInvestigation

articles.title: Beauty Parlour Staff Beat Owner With 43 Slippers Over Alleged Water Tampering in Rajasthan
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Four women working at a beauty parlour in Rajasthan's Churu district allegedly assaulted the parlour owner with slippers after accusing him of mixing an intoxicating substance into their drinking water.

body.html:
Four women working at a beauty parlour in Rajasthan's Churu district allegedly assaulted the parlour owner with slippers after accusing him of mixing an intoxicating substance into their drinking water.

The incident took place on June 29 in Sadulpur, while the women lodged a formal complaint at Rajgarh Police Station on Thursday. A video of the incident surfaced on Friday, showing the owner allegedly mixing something into a container of drinking water before the women confront and beat him with slippers. According to reports, he was allegedly hit 43 times within six minutes.

In their complaint, the women said they had been working at the beauty parlour since March 2026. They alleged that the owner, Bhawani Shankar Khatri, initially visited only for accounting work but later started insisting on entering the parlour regularly.

The women claimed they first became suspicious on June 27 that the owner was mixing something into their drinking water, but did not have any evidence. On June 29, they secretly recorded the parlour using a mobile phone camera and allegedly captured him mixing a substance into the water. They then informed their family members and left the parlour.

The women have demanded a fair investigation and legal action against the accused.

Rajgarh Police Station House Officer Rajesh Sihag said a complaint has been received from the women and the matter is under investigation. He said appropriate action will be taken based on the findings.

Meanwhile, Bhawani Shankar Khatri denied the allegations. He claimed that his beauty parlour had not been doing well for some time, so he had placed yellow mustard seeds inside the parlour and mixed Gangajal (holy water) into the drinking water as part of a religious practice.

Police are investigating the allegations and are yet to confirm whether any intoxicating substance was actually mixed into the water.

#Rajasthan #Churu #CrimeNews #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: Free Biryani Offer Sparks Chaos in Hanamkonda as Hundreds Rush to Newly Opened Hotel
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A free biryani giveaway at the inauguration of a newly opened hotel in Telangana's Hanamkonda triggered chaotic scenes on Thursday after a massive crowd gathered to avail of the offer.

body.html:
A free biryani giveaway at the inauguration of a newly opened hotel in Telangana's Hanamkonda triggered chaotic scenes on Thursday after a massive crowd gathered to avail of the offer.

The incident took place on July 2 after the management of Surabhi Grand Hotel announced that it would distribute 300 free biryani packets as part of its inaugural celebrations.

According to reports, nearly 1,000 people turned up at the hotel, far exceeding the organisers' expectations. As people rushed to collect the free food packets, the situation turned chaotic, with jostling and pushing reported among those waiting in line.

Police personnel rushed to the spot and brought the crowd under control, preventing any injuries or other untoward incidents.

The hotel management had earlier announced the distribution of 300 free biryani packets to mark the opening of the establishment. The unexpected turnout led to overcrowding outside the hotel before the situation was brought under control by the police.

articles.title: Wife Allegedly Kills Husband, Buries Body Under Bathroom Floor, Fakes Disappearance for 45 Days
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman has been accused of murdering her husband, burying his body beneath the bathroom floor of their house, and concealing it with fresh plaster and tiles in Uttar Pradesh's Agra.

body.html:
A woman has been accused of murdering her husband, burying his body beneath the bathroom floor of their house, and concealing it with fresh plaster and tiles in Uttar Pradesh's Agra.

The accused, identified as Ruby Sharma, allegedly kept up the pretence that her husband, Surendra Sharma, had gone missing for 45 days before the crime came to light.

The incident took place in the Prakshi Tower police outpost area under Sikandra Police Station.

According to police, Surendra Sharma had been missing since May 18. Ruby filed a missing person complaint on May 26 and repeatedly told family members and neighbours that her husband had disappeared.

On Friday, July 3, police visited the house for verification in connection with the missing person case. During the visit, officers grew suspicious of Ruby's behaviour. Based on information provided by the deceased's brother, they searched the house and noticed suspicious signs around the bathroom floor.

After digging up the bathroom floor, police recovered Surendra's body, shocking residents and drawing a large crowd to the spot.

Preliminary investigation revealed that after allegedly murdering her husband, Ruby buried the body beneath the bathroom floor before covering it with plaster and installing new tiles to conceal the crime.

Police suspect that another person may have been involved in the murder and are investigating that angle.

The body has been sent for post-mortem examination, while Ruby Sharma has been taken into custody and is being interrogated regarding the motive and sequence of events.

According to police, a missing person case was registered at Sikandra Police Station on May 26, 2026. During the investigation, it emerged that the missing man's wife had allegedly murdered him and buried his body under the bathroom floor.

Police recovered the body on July 3 after breaking open the bathroom floor. Following inquest proceedings, the body was sent to the mortuary for post-mortem. Further legal action is underway based on the evidence collected.

#Agra #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #MurderCase #BreakingNews

articles.title: Cyberabad Traffic Constable Accused of Communal Remarks During Parking Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Cyberabad traffic constable has been accused of making communal remarks at a Muslim woman and her teenage son during a dispute over a parked motorcycle in Hyderabad's Gachibowli. A video of the incident has since gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A Cyberabad traffic constable has been accused of making communal remarks at a Muslim woman and her teenage son during a dispute over a parked motorcycle in Hyderabad's Gachibowli. A video of the incident has since gone viral on social media.

The incident reportedly took place around noon on Thursday, July 2, near a BP petrol station opposite the IKEA exit gate on the Gachibowli-Raidurg stretch.

According to a complaint filed by Mohammed Sameer, his wife and son had parked their motorcycle behind barricades on a closed stretch of road, where three other bikes were also parked. When they returned, they found the road barricaded and requested the traffic constable, identified as J. Mallesham, to move the barricades so they could retrieve the vehicle.

The complaint alleges that the constable refused, stating that the area was not meant for parking, and allegedly abused the woman and her son while threatening them. During the argument, he allegedly remarked, "This is not Pakistan and Afghanistan to park as you like."

According to the complaint, the constable then began recording the family on his personal mobile phone.

In the viral video, the argument escalates as the officer continues filming. The woman's son is heard asking, "If we are Muslim, will you call us Pakistanis? How can you harass us like that?"

The constable is heard responding that traffic rules had been violated and that there should be consequences for breaking them. The teenager, however, claims the no-parking sign was placed on the main road and was not visible from where the motorcycle had been parked. He also says he had already apologised.

The woman further alleges that the constable spoke disrespectfully to her son, asking him to remove his earphones and questioning whether he had "gone mad." The officer, however, says he only asked the teenager to remove his earphones so he could hear what was being said.

Towards the end of the video, the teenager reminds the constable that he is a public servant and asks to see his nameplate. The officer identifies himself as "Malleshwaram" before the video ends.

Mohammed Sameer, in his complaint to the Joint Commissioner of Police (Traffic), Cyberabad, sought disciplinary action against the constable, alleging that the remarks were discriminatory and contrary to the constitutional duty of a police officer to remain impartial and protect all citizens irrespective of religion.

The Cyberabad Traffic Police are yet to issue an official response. It is also unclear whether any action has been initiated against the constable.

#Hyderabad #Cyberabad #Gachibowli #TrafficPolice #ViralVideo
